properties.name: spring.profiles.active
properties.description: Active Spring profile. Set via env SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.

properties.name: sbp.reference.port
properties.description: HTTP port for the reference service. Overridden by env REFERENCE_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.host
properties.description: PostgreSQL host. Overridden by env REFERENCE_DB_HOST.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.port
properties.description: PostgreSQL port. Overridden by env REFERENCE_DB_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.name
properties.description: PostgreSQL database name. Overridden by env REFERENCE_DB_NAME.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.username
properties.description: PostgreSQL user. Overridden by env REFERENCE_DB_USERNAME.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.password
properties.description: PostgreSQL password. Overridden by env REFERENCE_DB_PASSWORD.

properties.name: sbp.reference.datasource.timezone
properties.description: IANA timezone for JDBC and Hibernate.
